gloss: crotch; groin; fork (of a tree or road)

definitions.explanation: The part of the body where the legs join, and the inside of the thighs.

definitions.gloss: fork (of a tree, road or river)
definitions.explanation: A place where something divides into two branches.

examples.english: To sit with one's legs apart.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{股関節|こかんせつ}→股関節：17034_kokansetsu⟧: hip joint
- {内股|うちまた}: inner thigh; walking pigeon-toed
- ⟦{大股|おおまた}→大股：32862_oomata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk with long strides
- {二股|ふたまた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to two-time; to play both sides
- {股|また}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かける: to travel all over (⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{股|また}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かける, to range the whole world)

- また (again; also) is a different word with the same sound; written in kana
